jobs.title: VP of Product Management
jobs.description:
About SpotOn

We’re not just building restaurant tech, we’re giving independent restaurants the tools to compete and win. From our award-winning point-of-sale to AI-powered profit tools, everything we do helps operators boost profit, work smarter, and keep their best people. And every solution is backed by real humans who actually give a sh*t about helping restaurants succeed.

Named the #1 Restaurant POS by G2 (Summer 2026), based on ratings from real users
Rated the top-rated point-of-sale (POS) for restaurants, bars, retail, and small businesses by Capterra users
Awarded Great Places to Work and Built In’s Best Workplaces for multiple years running

We move fast, care hard, and fight for independent restaurant operators to do what they love, and love doing it. If you’re looking to make an impact with heart and hustle, SpotOn is the place for you.

The Role

We’re looking for an experienced Product Leader who is capable of leading a team to build

innovative products. This Product Leader will oversee our Intelligence, Reporting, and

Innovative AI teams. They will report directly to our Global Head of Product Management and work closely with our C-Suite to create strategy, define roadmaps, and build genuinely impactful, innovative products.

In This Role You Will

Be a driving force of defining the product strategy for your product areas and a major

contributor to SpotOn’s overall product strategy.

Be data driven and deep into the metrics and efforts that achieve the goals of our

company and our customers.

Manage a team of Product Managers as the team investigates market opportunities,

builds the product roadmap, and makes strategic adjustments as needed based on client

needs, data, and business priority.

Be forward thinking in your approach to product vision and design. The world is rapidly

evolving with AI and we believe that SpotOn must lead, not chase if we want to be

authors of the future of the industry we love.

Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, Product Management, Sales and

Support to elicit, understand, rationalize, and prioritize requests for new functionality.

Assess market competition, client preferences, emerging technologies, and industry

trends to identify

Qualifications

7+ years of relevant product management experience or equivalent, with at least 5 years

managing and coaching a team of Product Managers.

Fluency with AI tools like Claude, Vercel, or similar.
Demonstrated instances of “getting out of the building” to put yourself in the customer’s

shoes to understand their needs / how they interact with our products. Note: it is not

uncommon for Product leaders at SpotOn to work shifts at our customer’s

restaurants/bars.

Experience and comfort operating in metrics-driven work environments that leverages

data to make informed decisions.

Strong understanding of the product development lifecycle and experience designing

and delivering quality products.

An ability to manage multiple projects in an iterative process.
Strong communication and presentation skills. This role requires presenting to multiple

audiences ranging from groups of SMBs to seasoned Investors and Executives.

Experience making decisions with imperfect information and comfort managing teams

through ambiguity, and complexity.

Past restaurant experience, especially working in a restaurant, is a serious plus, but not

a hard requirement

Compensation

Base pay: range starts at $275,000 -$320,000 for this role
Equity package: TBD based on the seniority of the candidate.
Offers will be reflective of the candidate’s location and experience.

Benefits

At SpotOn, we put people above everything else. We’re known for our innovative software and

technology solutions, but we stand out because of the hard-working humans behind the tech.

We can’t take care of our clients without taking care of our employees first, and that’s why we

invest in you with a competitive benefits package which includes:

Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
401k with company match
RSUs
Paid vacation, 10 company holidays, sick time, and volunteer time off
Employee Resource Groups to build community and inclusion at work
Monthly cell phone and internet stipend
Tuition reimbursement for up to $2,000 per calendar year to assist with your professional development

We will never ask candidates to pay fees, purchase equipment, or share sensitive personal or financial information during the hiring process. All legitimate communication from our recruiting team will come from an official company email address (@ spoton.com ). If something seems suspicious, please contact us at careers@spoton.com .

SpotOn is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

For U.S. based roles, work authorization in the U.S. is required. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

SpotOn is an E-Verify company.

Compensation Range: $275K - $320K

jobs.title: Vice President Product Manager: Client Platform Multi-Factor Authentication
jobs.description:
Purchase, NY/ 1 New York Plaza

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities, investment management, and wealth management services to clients worldwide. Digital Client Experience & Platforms is building secure, scalable, and intuitive client-facing capabilities that help protect clients, enable digital adoption, and support trusted engagement across web and mobile channels.

We are seeking a Vice President, Product Manager to own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for client platform Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). This leader will serve as a builder-operator for a critical identity and security platform, delivering secure-by-design authentication capabilities that protect clients while preserving a seamless digital experience. The role requires strong product judgment, execution discipline, and the ability to align engineering, cybersecurity, fraud, risk, legal, compliance, design, operations, and channel stakeholders around a measurable roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Platform Ownership

Own the MFA product vision, multi-year roadmap, and quarterly delivery plans across web, mobile, and shared client platform capabilities.
Define reusable authentication capabilities, adoption patterns, and integration standards that can scale across multiple client journeys and channel teams.
Translate security, fraud, regulatory, and client experience objectives into clear product outcomes, prioritized features, and measurable success criteria.
Develop the target-state roadmap for enrollment, step-up authentication, trusted devices, device binding, recovery, factor management, and channel migration.

Delivery, Execution & Operating Discipline

Lead cross-functional delivery with engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, fraud, operations, design, and channel product teams from discovery through production launch.
Convert product strategy into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, release plans, and launch readiness artifacts.
Manage dependencies across identity, session management, device intelligence, fraud decisioning, client servicing, contact center tooling, and digital channels.
Drive disciplined product rituals including prioritization, backlog grooming, stakeholder reviews, delivery governance, testing, release readiness, and post-launch validation.

Risk, Controls, Privacy & Governance

Partner with Technology, Cybersecurity, Fraud Operations, Chief Data Office/Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Internal Audit to ensure MFA capabilities meet internal control standards and external regulatory expectations.
Own product documentation and governance artifacts, including risk assessments, control mappings, audit evidence, exception handling, change approvals, and operational readiness materials.
Embed privacy, consent, data minimization, resiliency, and auditability considerations into product design and delivery decisions.

Client Experience, Adoption & Operational Excellence

Optimize MFA experiences to reduce friction while maintaining strong protection, including prompt frequency, factor choice, enrollment completion, recovery flows, accessibility, and servicing escalation paths.
Partner with UX research, design, analytics, and servicing teams to validate journeys, identify drop-off drivers, and improve client and advisor outcomes.
Define production health expectations, including observability, incident readiness, defect prioritization, operational playbooks, and post-launch performance reviews.
Coordinate rollout, communications, training, and change management with digital channels, field/service organizations, and support teams.

Metrics & Continuous Improvement

Define and track product, risk, and operational KPIs including MFA enrollment rate, challenge success rate, authentication latency, factor adoption, step-up frequency, fraud loss reduction, account takeover indicators, recovery completion, contact drivers, and defect trends.
Use data, client feedback, incident learnings, and control findings to continuously improve the roadmap and quantify risk reduction, resiliency, and experience gains.

Required Qualifications

5-7 years of product management experience, including ownership of platform capabilities used by multiple applications, channels, or teams.
Demonstrated experience delivering authentication, identity, security, fraud, risk, or client protection products in a regulated environment; financial services experience strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of MFA methods and tradeoffs, including push, OTP, authenticator apps, device binding, trusted devices, account recovery, biometric-enabled flows, FIDO2/WebAuthn, and risk-based or adaptive authentication.
Proven ability to influence and execute across engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, fraud, risk, compliance, legal, design, analytics, operations, and senior business stakeholders.
Experience defining product metrics, analyzing performance data, and using evidence to prioritize roadmap investments and operational improvements.
Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills, with comfort presenting roadmap decisions, delivery progress, risks, tradeoffs, and funding needs to senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with identity standards and protocols such as OAuth/OIDC and SAML, and familiarity with modern web and mobile authentication patterns.
Experience with device intelligence, fraud decisioning, risk scoring, account takeover prevention, or AI-enabled risk signal integration.
Experience improving account recovery, identity proofing, client support tooling, and operational workflows for identity-related issues.
Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, agile delivery practices, governance forums, and product financials or investment planning.

Core Competencies

Platform-first product strategy and roadmap ownership
Security-by-design mindset balanced with client experience outcomes
Structured execution, delivery governance, and operational discipline
Risk, controls, privacy, and compliance fluency
Data-driven decision-making, measurement, and continuous improvement
Executive communication, stakeholder influence, and cross-functional leadership

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $110,000 and $190,000 per year at

the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

jobs.description:
Curinos empowers financial institutions to put customers at the center of every decision. Our AI-first platform transforms proprietary data, advanced analytics and deep financial services expertise into timely recommendations - delivered right where teams work. The result: confident decisions, stronger customer relationships, and lasting, profitable growth.

Curinos operates under a hybrid modality and has office locations in New York, Chicago, Boston, Toronto, and London. This role is open to hybrid/ remote candidates based in the United States.

Job Description

Curinos is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead key components of the Curinos One Platform, our next-generation AI-powered Decision Intelligence Platform for financial institutions.

Curinos One brings together proprietary market intelligence, customer data, predictive analytics, machine learning, and workflow automation to help financial institutions make smarter decisions across customer acquisition, growth, pricing, and relationship management. Our vision is to transform fragmented data and disconnected workflows into a unified platform that delivers actionable intelligence directly within the decision-making process.

As Director of Product Management, you will oversee a portfolio of platform capabilities and lead a team of 2 to 4 Product Managers responsible for defining, building, launching, and scaling key modules of the Curinos One platform. You will identify new market opportunities, establish product-market fit, drive platform adoption, and help shape the long-term evolution of Curinos One.

Responsibilities

Set Portfolio Strategy & Drive Organizational Alignment

Set the vision, strategic direction, and measurable outcomes for a portfolio of Curinos One capabilities, ensuring alignment with company strategy and market priorities
Translate enterprise goals into clear mandates for Product Managers and cross-functional leaders, creating shared context while empowering teams to determine how best to deliver outcomes
Lead portfolio-level planning and governance across pods, making deliberate trade-offs among growth, client impact, platform leverage, capacity, risk, and technical sustainability
Influence executive stakeholders and functional leaders to secure investment, resolve competing priorities, and maintain accountability for portfolio outcomes

Coach & Develop Product Managers

Lead, mentor, and coach a team of 2 to 4 Product Managers, strengthening their capabilities in discovery, strategy, delivery, and stakeholder influence
Translate complex product, market, and technology concepts into clear, teachable frameworks
Create a culture of ownership, curiosity, accountability, and continuous improvement

Champion Quality & Consistency

Set expectations for excellence in product discovery, design, launch, and ongoing optimization.
Review and guide work across pods to ensure precision, usability, strategic alignment, and measurable impact
Identify opportunities to standardize, streamline, and scale product practices across teams

Lead Market and Ecosystem Thinking

Serve as an internal authority on client needs, market shifts, competitive dynamics, and emerging technologies within your product domain
Maintain current expertise across modern customer acquisition, marketing technology, advertising technology, and decisioning ecosystems
Connect platform investments and product decisions directly to client outcomes and Curinos business goals

Foster Cross-Functional Leadership

Build strong, solution-oriented partnerships across Engineering, UX, Data Science, Advisory, Sales, Marketing, and Product Delivery
Create clarity, resolve issues directly, remove roadblocks, and communicate decisions and learnings across pods and functions
Contribute to company-wide initiatives that strengthen product performance, culture, innovation, and client impact

Salary Range: $
180,000- $190,000 USD (plus Bonus)

Desired Skills & Expertise

8+ years of Product Management experience, including experience leading Product Managers and cross-functional product organizations in a growing enterprise SaaS business
Demonstrated success launching new products, establishing product-market fit, and leading substantial 0-to-1 product initiatives from initial concept through commercial adoption and scale
Proven experience identifying emerging market opportunities, validating customer problems, and making evidence-based investment decisions in ambiguous environments
Experience building and scaling SaaS, data-intensive, analytics, AI-driven, or platform software products
Required professional experience in Advertising Technology (AdTech), Marketing Technology (MarTech), audience intelligence, customer acquisition, campaign optimization, media activation, and/or marketing decisioning systems
Strong working knowledge of modern customer acquisition ecosystems, including direct mail and digital channels, paid media, paid search, programmatic advertising, audience targeting, identity, attribution, measurement, and activation platforms.
Experience partnering directly with Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering, and Applied AI teams to bring predictive intelligence and AI-powered experiences to market
Ability to understand and translate predictive models, optimization approaches, experimentation, model performance, and AI-driven recommendations into intuitive customer-facing product experiences
Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise B2B software products in a user-centric Product Management role, managing multiple workstreams, and delivering effectively in an Agile environment
Exceptional communication, storytelling, and influencing skills, with the ability to connect product decisions to business strategy and explain nuanced ideas to executive clients and technical and non-technical stakeholders
High standards for quality and craftsmanship, combined with the ability to coach others to deliver the same
Strategic judgment that balances long-term platform vision with pragmatic execution and measurable results

Preferred Experience

Deep understanding of financial services, fintech, banking, or customer acquisition within a regulated industry.
Experience with customer data platforms, identity resolution, data clean rooms, and/or measurement platforms.

Why work at Curinos?

Competitive benefits, including a range of Financial, Health and Lifestyle benefits to choose from
Flexible working options, including home working, flexible hours and part time options, depending on the role requirements – please ask!
Unlimited PTO policy, floating holidays, volunteering days and a day off for your birthday!
Learning and development tools to assist with your career development
Work with industry leading Subject Matter Experts and specialist products
Regular social events and networking opportunities
Collaborative, supportive culture, including an active DE&I program
Employee Assistance Program which provides expert third-party advice on wellbeing, relationships, legal and financial matters, as well as access to counselling services

Applying

We know that sometimes the 'perfect candidate' doesn't exist, and that people can be put off applying for a job if they don't meet all the requirements. If you're excited about working for us and have relevant skills or experience, please go ahead and apply. You could be just what we need!

If you need any adjustments to support your application, such as information in alternative formats, special requirements to access our buildings or adjusted interview formats please contact us at careers@curinos.com and we’ll do everything we can to help.

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director Product Management - Technical

About Mastercard

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Role Summary

We are looking for a **Principal Product Manager – Technical** to lead product strategy and execution for **global, real‑time switching and authorization platforms**.In this role, you will own the vision, roadmap, and delivery of **mission‑critical transaction processing capabilities** that operate at massive scale with strict requirements for availability, latency, resiliency, and correctness. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, operations, and business leaders to deliver platforms that support billions of transactions and enable reliable, secure payment experiences worldwide. This is a **senior individual contributor role** with broad influence across teams, regions, and portfolios.

What You’ll Do

Product Strategy & Vision* Define and own the long‑term product vision and strategy for switching and authorization platforms.* Translate complex customer, business, and ecosystem needs into clear product roadmaps and priorities.* Identify and drive new platform capabilities that improve transaction reliability, scalability, and performance.* Make data‑driven prioritization decisions balancing customer value, risk, regulatory needs, and time‑to‑market. Technical Product Leadership* Serve as the product authority for real‑time authorization and switching systems.* Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to influence design decisions while maintaining product accountability.* Define clear product requirements, including functional behavior and non‑functional expectations such as availability, latency, throughput, and resiliency.* Ensure operational readiness, monitoring, and observability are integral to product delivery. Roadmap & Execution Ownership* Own and manage multi‑year product roadmaps, including near‑term delivery and long‑term modernization initiatives.* Define epics, features, and user stories with clear outcomes and success metrics.* Evaluate trade‑offs between new capabilities, technical sustainability, ecosystem impact, and operational risk.* Use in‑market performance data and platform metrics to continuously refine priorities. Stakeholder & Customer Engagement* Represent the voice of customers, partners, and internal stakeholders in product decisions.* Collaborate across product, engineering, operations, risk, and business teams to drive alignment and execution.* Communicate complex technical and product concepts clearly to executive and non‑technical audiences. Leadership & Impact* Act as a mentor and role model for other product managers.* Influence across the organization without direct authority.* Raise the bar for product excellence, technical rigor, and customer focus.

All About You

Required Qualifications*

Significant experience in **Technical Product Management** for large‑scale, distributed, high‑availability systems.* Strong understanding of real‑time platforms, APIs, integration patterns, and modern software delivery practices.* Proven ability to lead complex initiatives and influence senior stakeholders across a matrixed organization.* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have Qualifications. While not required, experience or familiarity with **payment cryptographic and security services** is a strong plus, including:* EMV and authorization cryptographic flows such as **ARQC, ARPC**, and related issuer validation mechanisms* **Account Authentication Value (AAV)** and e‑commerce authentication constructs* **PIN‑based services**, including PIN validation and PIN translation* **Tokenization and digital enablement services**, such as **MDES (Mastercard Digital Enablement Service)*** **Magnetic Stripe services** and legacy transaction processing concepts* Working knowledge of how cryptographic services integrate with authorization and switching platforms in a real‑time payment environment. This knowledge helps accelerate impact but is **not a prerequisite** for success in the role.Why Join Us* Work on platforms that power **global commerce at massive scale*** Influence products with **network‑wide, real‑world impact*** Collaborate with world‑class engineers, architects, and product leaders* Grow your career while shaping the future of digital payments.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Mastercard is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best-in-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on-site fitness facilities in some locations.

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities, investment management, and wealth management services to clients worldwide. Digital Client Experience & Platforms is building secure, scalable, and intuitive client-facing capabilities that help protect clients, enable digital adoption, and support trusted engagement across web and mobile channels.

We are seeking a Vice President, Product Manager to own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for client platform Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). This leader will serve as a builder-operator for a critical identity and security platform, delivering secure-by-design authentication capabilities that protect clients while preserving a seamless digital experience. The role requires strong product judgment, execution discipline, and the ability to align engineering, cybersecurity, fraud, risk, legal, compliance, design, operations, and channel stakeholders around a measurable roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Platform Ownership

Own the MFA product vision, multi-year roadmap, and quarterly delivery plans across web, mobile, and shared client platform capabilities.
Define reusable authentication capabilities, adoption patterns, and integration standards that can scale across multiple client journeys and channel teams.
Translate security, fraud, regulatory, and client experience objectives into clear product outcomes, prioritized features, and measurable success criteria.
Develop the target-state roadmap for enrollment, step-up authentication, trusted devices, device binding, recovery, factor management, and channel migration.

Lead cross-functional delivery with engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, fraud, operations, design, and channel product teams from discovery through production launch.
Convert product strategy into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, release plans, and launch readiness artifacts.
Manage dependencies across identity, session management, device intelligence, fraud decisioning, client servicing, contact center tooling, and digital channels.
Drive disciplined product rituals including prioritization, backlog grooming, stakeholder reviews, delivery governance, testing, release readiness, and post-launch validation.

Risk, Controls, Privacy & Governance

Partner with Technology, Cybersecurity, Fraud Operations, Chief Data Office/Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Internal Audit to ensure MFA capabilities meet internal control standards and external regulatory expectations.
Own product documentation and governance artifacts, including risk assessments, control mappings, audit evidence, exception handling, change approvals, and operational readiness materials.
Embed privacy, consent, data minimization, resiliency, and auditability considerations into product design and delivery decisions.

Client Experience, Adoption & Operational Excellence

Optimize MFA experiences to reduce friction while maintaining strong protection, including prompt frequency, factor choice, enrollment completion, recovery flows, accessibility, and servicing escalation paths.
Partner with UX research, design, analytics, and servicing teams to validate journeys, identify drop-off drivers, and improve client and advisor outcomes.
Define production health expectations, including observability, incident readiness, defect prioritization, operational playbooks, and post-launch performance reviews.
Coordinate rollout, communications, training, and change management with digital channels, field/service organizations, and support teams.

Metrics & Continuous Improvement

Define and track product, risk, and operational KPIs including MFA enrollment rate, challenge success rate, authentication latency, factor adoption, step-up frequency, fraud loss reduction, account takeover indicators, recovery completion, contact drivers, and defect trends.
Use data, client feedback, incident learnings, and control findings to continuously improve the roadmap and quantify risk reduction, resiliency, and experience gains.

Required Qualifications

5-7 years of product management experience, including ownership of platform capabilities used by multiple applications, channels, or teams.
Demonstrated experience delivering authentication, identity, security, fraud, risk, or client protection products in a regulated environment; financial services experience strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of MFA methods and tradeoffs, including push, OTP, authenticator apps, device binding, trusted devices, account recovery, biometric-enabled flows, FIDO2/WebAuthn, and risk-based or adaptive authentication.
Proven ability to influence and execute across engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, fraud, risk, compliance, legal, design, analytics, operations, and senior business stakeholders.
Experience defining product metrics, analyzing performance data, and using evidence to prioritize roadmap investments and operational improvements.
Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills, with comfort presenting roadmap decisions, delivery progress, risks, tradeoffs, and funding needs to senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with identity standards and protocols such as OAuth/OIDC and SAML, and familiarity with modern web and mobile authentication patterns.
Experience with device intelligence, fraud decisioning, risk scoring, account takeover prevention, or AI-enabled risk signal integration.
Experience improving account recovery, identity proofing, client support tooling, and operational workflows for identity-related issues.
Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, agile delivery practices, governance forums, and product financials or investment planning.

Core Competencies

Platform-first product strategy and roadmap ownership
Security-by-design mindset balanced with client experience outcomes
Structured execution, delivery governance, and operational discipline
Risk, controls, privacy, and compliance fluency
Data-driven decision-making, measurement, and continuous improvement
Executive communication, stakeholder influence, and cross-functional leadership

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Vida Health is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Growth
to own the day-to-day execution and continuous improvement of critical pieces of the member journey - onboarding and retention. You will drive engagement, retention, and health outcomes for hundreds of thousands of members across Vida’s clinical and behavioral programs.

This role sits within Vida’s Member Experience group, which owns the full consumer journey from onboarding through long-term engagement and retention. Reporting to the Director of Member Experience, you will partner with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Clinical teams to ship high-impact product improvements while helping lay the foundation for Vida’s next-generation personalized experience.

This is a high-autonomy IC role with room to grow. You will balance near-term product execution (improving core features, running experiments, reducing friction) with contributing to longer-term 2.0 vision work. The ideal candidate is a strong executor who can drive results in the current product while thinking strategically about where the experience needs to go.

Responsibilities

Drive growth and onboarding across landing page, eligibility, and onboarding for Vida Health’s core member funnel.
Devise experiments based on rigorous, thoughtful, data-backed hypotheses.
Iterate on experiments by analyzing results and addressing new bottlenecks
Re-architect onboarding to reduce early drop-off and drove lift in registration.
Own the member growth product backlog and support roadmap development: prioritize, scope, ship, and measure improvements to early experience (landing pages, onboarding, first clinical visit).
Drive A/B testing and rapid experimentation to improve engagement, activation, and retention metrics.
Manage bug triage and quality for the member experience; ensure a reliable, performant product.
Partner with Engineering and Design to maintain product velocity, unblock delivery, and manage technical tradeoffs.
Translate client requests and stakeholder input into well-scoped product work without compromising member experience quality.
Own member experience metrics, including engagement, retention, churn, activation rate, and NPS.
Build, maintain, and report on dashboards in Looker and PostHog; establish regular data review cadence and ensure learnings are socialized.
Analyze user behavior to identify friction points, drop-off patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
Design and interpret experiments; bring data-informed recommendations to product and leadership forums.
Work closely with Design to develop and iterate on UX improvements and ensure member-first thinking in all product decisions.
Partner with Clinical Teams to ensure product changes support care delivery, medication management, and coaching workflows.
Collaborate with other PM's to ensure seamless handoff from enrollment into the core experience.
Coordinate with marketing to improve re-engagement and lifecycle messaging.
Socialize updates and learnings clearly and consistently with cross-functional partners across the organization.
Contribute to the Vida 2.0 vision by surfacing insights from current product performance, member feedback, and competitive analysis.
Help stand up user research infrastructure: recruit participants, support moderated testing, synthesize findings.
Support concept validation and prototype testing for next-generation member experiences.
Additional responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree at a minimum.
3-5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years shipping consumer or patient-facing digital products.
Proven track record improving engagement, retention, or activation metrics in a mobile or web product.
Strong analytical skills: comfortable with SQL, product analytics tools (Looker, PostHog, Amplitude, or similar), and A/B testing frameworks.
Experience running the full product lifecycle: discovery, scoping, shipping, measuring, iterating.
Excellent cross-functional communication: able to work effectively with Engineering, Design, Clinical, and Business stakeholders.
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with shifting priorities.
Clear, concise writer who can turn complexity into actionable product artifacts.

Preferred

Healthcare or digital health experience: chronic care, telehealth, behavior change programs, GLP-1 management, or similar.
Experience with personalization, recommendation systems, or AI/ML-powered product features.
Familiarity with behavioral design frameworks (BJ Fogg, COM-B, habit formation, nudge theory).
Experience with React Native or mobile app development workflows.
Background in B2B2C products where you have balanced end-user experience with enterprise client needs.
